sources.psrk4: Horstmann, S., Jabłoniec, A., Krafczyk, J., Fischer, K., Gmehling, J. PSRK group contribution equation of state: comprehensive revision and extension IV, including critical constants and alpha-function parameters for 1000 components. Fluid Phase Equilibria 227 (2005) 157-164. Read from the chemicals library data files.
sources.poling: Poling, B. E., Prausnitz, J. M., O'Connell, J. P. The Properties of Gases and Liquids, 5th ed., McGraw-Hill, 2001, Appendix A. Read from the chemicals library data files, which store log10(P/Pa) = A - B/(T/K + C).
sources.chemsep_nrtl: ChemSep interaction parameter data, file 'DECHEMA NRTL at P = 1 atm' (copyright 2008 H. Kooijman and R. Taylor, Artistic License 2.0). The file gives A12 and A21 in cal/mol with tau_ij = A_ij / RT; read from the thermo library data files and converted to J/mol.
sources.chemsep_pr: ChemSep interaction parameter data, file 'DECHEMA Peng-Robinson Parameters' (copyright 2009 H. Kooijman and R. Taylor, Artistic License 2.0). Read from the thermo library data files.
sources.iupac_aw: Molar mass from the molecular formula and IUPAC abridged standard atomic weights (2021).
sources.derived: Calculated here: temperature at which the Antoine equation gives 101 325 Pa.
sources.libraries: Bell, C. and contributors. chemicals: Chemical properties component of Chemical Engineering Design Library (ChEDL), and thermo: Chemical properties component of ChEDL. https://github.com/CalebBell/chemicals, https://github.com/CalebBell/thermo (MIT License).
sources.vanlaar_fit: van Laar parameters A_ij(T) = a_ij + b_ij/T regressed in this project (scripts/fit_vanlaar.py) to ln(gamma) from the DECHEMA NRTL parameters of the same pair (ChemSep file 'DECHEMA NRTL at P = 1 atm', see chemsep_nrtl), over x1 = 0.01 to 0.99 and the temperature range given with each pair.

meta.notes: Values are reproduced from the cited sources for teaching use. Check them against the original publication before relying on them.
